message.content: {"verdict": "gap", "citations": ["rbi-13141"], "confidence": 0.95, "rationale": "While the policy allows rejecting applications or periodic updations when documents are not furnished within the stipulated time, it omits the mandatory regulatory requirement that any such rejection must be made with proper application of mind and that the officer concerned must duly record the reason(s) for rejection in terms of paragraph 18 of the RBI Commercial Banks KYC Directions, 2025."}
